🧠 BTCUSDT 4H SMC TEST — Binance

BTC is showing a bullish recovery on the 4H, but I would NOT chase the current move.

The important sequence:
• Sell-side liquidity was taken around $84,525 on Oct 3.
• Price reclaimed the $84,890–$85,037 area.
• The latest closed 4H candle pushed through $85,037 and closed around $85,106.
• The current 16:00–20:00 candle is still forming and has already traded up to ~$85,428.

SMC read:
🟢 Bias: Bullish recovery
🎯 Buy-side liquidity: ~$85,428 and above
📍 Bullish FVG developing: ~$84,890–$85,033
📍 Deeper demand: ~$84,525–$84,600

The cleaner trade is patience.

LONG SCENARIO:
Wait for price to retrace into the ~$84,890–$85,033 imbalance and show bullish displacement/5M confirmation.

Potential objectives:
→ $85,428
→ $85,600
→ $86,000+

Invalidation: sustained 4H acceptance below the demand/reclaim zone.

SHORT SCENARIO:
Only becomes interesting if BTC sweeps the ~$85,428 buy-side liquidity and then gives a clear bearish displacement/rejection. Without that confirmation, shorting into the recovery is low quality.

⚠️ The current 4H candle is incomplete, so this is a conditional setup — not a blind entry.
